scope: Development-only opt-in action policy. Native PMFS source update, candidate support, prior, probability map, top-5% position estimate and stop rule stay unchanged. No AOD filter or neural network participates.
runtime_inputs: Only completed normal ten-sample stop windows, their actual measured pose/time, Native's next requested goal, and the fixed VGR occupancy/navigation grid. No true source, MAP-as-home, hidden plume field, future readout, or candidate label enters the policy.
trigger: Use at most the first completed Native hit window at an actually reached stop, gas_above_threshold=true under the existing 0.1 ppm threshold, with t<=180 s. No second local cycle is started after this trigger.
common_local_departure: Both non-Native arms choose one reachable coarse-grid cell B 0.60-1.20 m from the hit anchor A, preferring a 0.90 m step aligned with the just-requested Native goal. Feasible B requires the unmodified VGR BFS path length <=2.70 m. Sort by descending directional cosine, then abs(distance-0.90), then x,y. If the Native requested goal equals A, use +x as the deterministic alignment direction. If no B exists, use the Native goal and consume the single trigger without a local cycle.
last_hit_control: After sampling at B, if B is a miss, return once to the last actual hit A by normal navigation and normal ten-sample stop window; then resume Native. If B is a hit, resume Native without returning. The control never creates a validation-derived goal C.
verified_local_arm: After sampling at B, return to A once regardless of B's hit status. If A is hit again, B was a miss, A-to-A revisit elapsed <=75 s, and t<=250 s, choose one reachable C at the coarse-grid cell center nearest A-(B-A), with geometric mirror error <=0.30 m, A-to-C distance 0.60-1.20 m, and BFS path length <=2.70 m. Sample C once by the normal ten-sample stop window, then resume Native. Otherwise revoke and resume Native.
revoke_conditions: Anchor revisit miss, elapsed >75 s, measurement pose >0.15 m from its commanded stop, duplicate or nonmonotonic measurement cycle/time, missing ten-sample window, unreachable B/A/C, or insufficient task time all revoke the temporary memory. No special belief update or re-use of the same sensor event occurs.
budget: Original 300 s task budget; all detours, re-visits, movement, and samples consume it. No altered speed, sensor, target, source, candidate support, or stop threshold. At most one A-B-A-C attempt per run.
diagnostic_only: Record y_A0, y_B, y_A2 and D_AB=y_B-(1-w)y_A0-w*y_A2 with w=(t_B-t_A0)/(t_A2-t_A0). D_AB is not a source likelihood or a claim that C is closer to the source. Binary hit/miss is the only validation condition.
comparison: Cached Native if exact runtime parity holds; Native plus last-hit return; Native plus verified local action. Same three already OPEN cases H01/H02/H03, one seed each, at most two new arms x three cases. Run H01 two new arms first and return; no automatic expansion.
primary_outcomes: Final available Native source-map estimate error to true source, geometric success <=0.5 m, wrong declaration, timeout, path length. Hit/return/validation rates are diagnostics only.
interpretation_boundary: This is a falsifiable local sampling heuristic under a standard Native inference engine, not a Bee-Nav replication, an unknown-source home vector, or an established main innovation. These cases are OPEN development data.
